_status: DEPLOYED & VERIFIED. Rule A (readOnly:true) + Rule B (invokedBy AWS-service) are LIVE and confirmed byte-for-byte via pipeline JSON export at updateTime 2026-08-22T09:59:26. Now 5 processors total (3 existing enumerated rules + A + B), all correct, no stray characters.
_design: Two new rules that catch read/automation noise the enumerated lists miss, using CloudTrail's OWN fields rather than a hand-maintained list of 800+ names.
_no_sample_note: Built against the DOCUMENTED, stable CloudTrail record schema (readOnly is a JSON boolean; invokedBy is the AWS-service caller string). Not a vendor guess. Still fails safe: if the real format differs, the rule drops nothing (no data loss).
_field_order_independent: Both rules match a single field anywhere in the body, so unlike the Zscaler rules they do NOT depend on field ordering.

processors._rule: A — drop everything AWS classifies as read-only. Biggest win; supersedes most of the 3 enumerated list rules.
processors._keeps: All readOnly:false events (creates/deletes/modifies/permission changes). KMS Encrypt/GenerateDataKey are readOnly:false so they are KEPT (consistent with prior KMS decision). Recon-detection use-case is covered by GuardDuty (already ingested).

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"readOnly\"\\s*:\\s*true")

processors._rule: B — drop AWS service-internal automation (AWS talking to itself).
processors._keeps: Anything invoked by a real user/role/external caller (no invokedBy AWS-service string). Smaller top-up win vs Rule A.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"invokedBy\"\\s*:\\s*\"[a-z0-9.\\-]+\\.amazonaws\\.com\"")
